title: 第21章 她是青云弟子足矣第22章 八强混战
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
擂台之上，气氛陡然绷紧。
周通深吸一口气，体内《惊雷剑诀》全力运转，周身隐隐有电蛇游走，空气中弥漫开淡淡的臭氧味道。
他手中长剑嗡鸣，剑尖遥指云杳杳，凌厉的剑意锁定了她。
“云师叔，小心了！”
话音未落，周通动了！
身形如电，疾扑而来！
手中长剑化作一道刺目雷光，撕裂空气，带着爆鸣之声，直刺云杳杳面门！
正是《惊雷剑诀》的起手式——惊雷一闪！
速度与爆发力极强！
台下响起一片惊呼！
周通一上来就动用杀招，显然毫无保留！
面对这迅若奔雷的一剑，云杳杳眼神微凝。
在她那微观感知下，这一剑的能量运行轨迹、力量凝聚点、甚至因高速而产生的细微空气波动都清晰可见。
快，且凝聚！
但并非毫无破绽！
过于追求速度与威力，导致剑招转换间有一丝极细微的灵力流转不畅！
她没有选择硬接，也没有完全躲避。
而是在剑尖即将临体的刹那，身体以一个不可思议的微小幅度侧身，同时右手食指与中指并拢，指尖缭绕着极其淡薄的灰芒（微弱混沌雷力模拟金系锋锐之气），精准无比地点向了长剑剑身侧面三分之一的某个点！
那里，正是这一剑力量流转的节点之一，也是相对最薄弱之处！
“叮！”

一声极其清脆的金铁交鸣之声响起！
云杳杳的指尖与雷光闪烁的剑身碰撞！
没有硬碰硬的爆炸，那狂暴的雷剑之力仿佛被点中了“死穴”
，猛地一颤，竟偏离了方向，擦着云杳杳的耳畔刺空！
带起的劲风吹动了她的发丝！
周通只觉剑身上传来一股诡异尖锐的震荡之力，手臂微微一麻，心中骇然！
他这全力一剑，竟被对方如此轻描淡写地一指破开？！
这是什么眼力？什么手法？！
但他战斗经验丰富，一击不中，立刻变招！
手腕一抖，长剑回旋，化作一片连绵不绝的雷光剑网，笼罩向云杳杳！
《惊雷剑诀》第二式——雷网交织！
剑光如瀑，雷声隆隆，攻势如水银泻地，看似毫无缝隙！
台下观众看得眼花缭乱，心都提到了嗓子眼！
云杳杳身处剑网中心，却依旧从容。
她的身法并非多么迅捷，却总能在间不容发之际，于剑光的缝隙中穿梭。
她的指尖或点、或弹、或拨，每一次出手都精准地落在剑势转换的节点或力量薄弱处，如同最高明的工匠，不断敲打着这张雷光剑网的承重节点！
“叮叮叮叮…！”
一连串密集如雨打芭蕉的轻响传出！
云杳杳的身影在雷光中若隐若现，看似惊险万分，实则每一步都踏在安全线上。
那狂暴的剑网竟始终无法真正触及她，反而在她的不断“敲打”

下，运转渐渐滞涩，光芒都黯淡了几分！
content_en:
On the stage, the atmosphere suddenly became tense.
Zhou Tong took a deep breath, and the "Thunder Sword Art" in his body was running at full strength. Electric snakes were faintly swimming around his body, and the air was filled with a faint smell of ozone.
The long sword in his hand buzzed, the tip of the sword pointed at Yun Yaoyao, and the sharp sword intent locked onto her.
"Uncle Yun, be careful!"
Before he finished speaking, Zhou Tong moved!
The figure is like lightning, rushing towards you!
The long sword in his hand turned into a dazzling bolt of lightning, tearing the air, with a roaring sound, and pierced Yun Yaoyao's front door!
It is exactly the starting move of "Thunder Sword Technique" - a flash of thunder!
Extremely fast and explosive!
There was an exclamation in the audience!
Zhou Tong used his killing moves as soon as he came up, obviously without any reservations!
Facing this sword that was as fast as thunder, Yun Yaoyao's eyes narrowed slightly.
Under her microscopic perception, the sword's energy trajectory, power concentration point, and even the subtle air fluctuations caused by high speed are clearly visible.
Quick and focused!
But it’s not without flaws!
The excessive pursuit of speed and power resulted in a very subtle flow of spiritual power between the sword moves!
She didn't choose to take it hard, nor did she avoid it completely.
But at the moment when the sword tip was about to approach, the body turned sideways at an incredibly small angle. At the same time, the index finger and middle finger of the right hand were close together. The fingertips were surrounded by an extremely thin gray light (the weak chaotic thunder simulated the sharp energy of the metal system), and they pointed at a certain point on the side of the long sword with incomparable precision!
There is one of the nodes where the power of this sword flows, and it is also the weakest point!
"Ding!"
An extremely clear sound of gold and iron echoed!
Yun Yaoyao's fingertips collided with the flashing sword blade!
There was no head-on explosion, the violent thunder sword power seemed to have hit the "death point"
, trembled suddenly, deviated from the direction, brushed Yun Yaoyao's ear and stabbed into the air!
The strong wind blew her hair!
Zhou Tong felt a strange and sharp concussive force coming from the sword, his arm went numb slightly, and his heart was horrified!
His sword with all his strength was broken by the opponent so lightly with just one finger? !
What kind of vision is this? What method? !
But he has rich fighting experience. If he misses a hit, he will immediately change his moves!
With a flick of his wrist, the long sword whirled, turning into a continuous network of lightning swords, covering Yun Yaoyao!
The second form of "Thunder Sword Technique" - intertwining thunder nets!
The sword light is like a waterfall, the thunder is rumbling, and the attack is like mercury pouring down the ground. There seems to be no gap!
The audience was dazzled and their hearts were in their throats!
Yun Yaoyao was in the center of the sword net, but still calm.
Her movement is not very fast, but she can always shuttle through the gaps of the sword light at the last moment.
Her fingertips were pointing, flicking, or plucking, and every time she took a shot, she accurately landed on the node of the sword's power transition or the weak point of strength. Like the most skilled craftsman, she kept hitting the load-bearing nodes of this lightning sword net!
"Ding ding ding ding...!"
A series of dense sounds like rain hitting banana trees came out!
Yun Yaoyao's figure loomed in the lightning. It seemed extremely dangerous, but in fact, every step was on the safe line.
The violent sword net could never really touch her, but instead kept "beating" her
Next, the operation gradually became stagnant, and the light dimmed a bit!
